description: This Java source file defines a final class 'DittoTrustManager' which implements the X509TrustManager interface. It provides customized trust management for SSL/TLS connections, including hostname and IP verification, and handling of certificate chains with optional revocation checks. The class includes static factory methods, overrides for trust verification methods, and internal utility functions for hostname processing.

classes.name: DittoTrustManager
classes.description: A custom trust manager that performs hostname/IP verification and certificate chain validation, with optional revocation checks.

methods.name: wrapTrustManagers
methods.description: Factory method to create an array of DittoTrustManager instances wrapping provided trust managers with revocation check configurations.

methods.name: checkClientTrusted
methods.description: Delegates client trust verification to the wrapped trust manager.

methods.name: checkServerTrusted
methods.description: Verifies server trust, including certificate chain validation and hostname/IP verification, with logging for exceptions.

methods.name: getAcceptedIssuers
methods.description: Returns the list of accepted certificate issuers from the delegated trust manager.
